info.name: Sudan Train - Complete API Test Suite
info.description:
Complete API test suite for Sudan Train Backend - organized by user type and mapped to refactored controllers.

🏗️ BACKEND ARCHITECTURE:
Route Base: Api/V1/
- Authentication endpoints: Api/V1/Authentication/*
- Infrastructure endpoints: Api/V1/Infrastructure/*

📁 CONTROLLER STRUCTURE (14 Controllers):

Authentication/ (6 controllers, 28 endpoints)
├── Core/
│   └── AuthController.cs (6 endpoints)
├── Security/
│   ├── TwoFactorAuthController.cs (6 endpoints)
│   └── PasswordController.cs (3 endpoints)
└── Account/
    ├── ProfileController.cs (6 endpoints)
    ├── SessionController.cs (3 endpoints)
    └── DeviceController.cs (4 endpoints)

Infrastructure/ (8 controllers, 41 endpoints)
├── Geography/
│   ├── AreasController.cs (5 endpoints)
│   ├── GovernoratesController.cs (5 endpoints)
│   └── CitiesController.cs (5 endpoints)
├── RailwayNetwork/
│   ├── StationsController.cs (5 endpoints)
│   └── RoutesController.cs (7 endpoints)
├── Fleet/
│   ├── TrainsController.cs (8 endpoints)
│   └── CoachesController.cs (1 endpoint)
└── Operations/
    └── TripsController.cs (5 endpoints)

✅ All routes unchanged - refactored for maintainability only

item.name: Customer
item.description:
Customer-facing APIs - mapped to Authentication controllers

📂 Controllers/Authentication/Core/AuthController.cs (6 endpoints)
   All routes: Api/V1/Authentication/*
   
   • POST /Register - Create new user account
   • POST /ConfirmEmail - Verify email with code
   • POST /Login - Authenticate user
   • POST /Logout - Revoke tokens [Requires Auth]
   • POST /RefreshToken - Get new access token
   • GET /ValidateToken - Check token validity

📂 Controllers/Authentication/Security/TwoFactorAuthController.cs (6 endpoints)
   All routes: Api/V1/Authentication/*
   
   • POST /EnableTwoFactor - Get QR code [Requires Auth]
   • POST /VerifyTwoFactor - Activate 2FA [Requires Auth]
   • POST /DisableTwoFactor - Turn off 2FA [Requires Auth]
   • POST /GenerateRecoveryCodes - Get backup codes [Requires Auth]
   • POST /LoginWithTwoFactor - Login with 2FA code
   • GET /GetTwoFactorStatus - Check 2FA status [Requires Auth]

📂 Controllers/Authentication/Security/PasswordController.cs (3 endpoints)
   All routes: Api/V1/Authentication/*
   
   • POST /ChangePassword - Update password [Requires Auth]
   • POST /SendResetPasswordCode - Request password reset
   • POST /ResetPassword - Reset with email code

📂 Controllers/Authentication/Account/ProfileController.cs (6 endpoints)
   All routes: Api/V1/Authentication/*
   
   • GET /Profile - Get user profile [Requires Auth]
   • PUT /Profile/Update - Update profile [Requires Auth]
   • POST /ChangeEmail - Request email change [Requires Auth]
   • POST /ConfirmEmailChange - Verify new email
   • GET /ExportData - Download user data [Requires Auth]
   • DELETE /Delete - Delete account [Requires Auth]

📂 Controllers/Authentication/Account/SessionController.cs (3 endpoints)
   All routes: Api/V1/Authentication/*
   
   • GET /Sessions - View active sessions [Requires Auth]
   • POST /Sessions/Terminate - End session [Requires Auth]
   • POST /Sessions/TerminateAll - Logout all devices [Requires Auth]

📂 Controllers/Authentication/Account/DeviceController.cs (4 endpoints)
   All routes: Api/V1/Authentication/*
   
   • GET /TrustedDevices - List trusted devices [Requires Auth]
   • POST /TrustDevice - Mark device as trusted [Requires Auth]
   • DELETE /TrustedDevices/Remove - Untrust device [Requires Auth]
   • GET /SecurityEvents - View security history [Requires Auth]

✅ Total: 28 endpoints across 6 controllers

item.name: Fleet Management
item.description:
Train fleet and coach management

Controllers:
  • Controllers/Infrastructure/Fleet/TrainsController.cs
  • Controllers/Infrastructure/Fleet/CoachesController.cs

Route: Api/V1/Infrastructure/Trains, Coaches
Features:
  - Train fleet CRUD operations
  - Bulk coach creation with auto-seat generation
  - Seat management by coach
  - Train classes: First/Second/Third

item.name: Trains
item.description:
Controller: Controllers/Infrastructure/Fleet/TrainsController.cs
Route: Api/V1/Infrastructure/Trains

Operations: CRUD + Get Coaches + Bulk Create Coaches
Authorization: Admin/Staff (CRUD), SuperAdmin (Delete)
Features: Train number, name (EN/AR), class type

item.name: Coaches & Seats
item.description:
Controller: Controllers/Infrastructure/Fleet/CoachesController.cs
Route: Api/V1/Infrastructure/Coaches

Endpoint: GET /Infrastructure/Coaches/{id}/Seats
Note: Coach creation via TrainsController POST {trainId}/Coaches/Bulk
Features: View all seats for a coach with availability status

item.name: Operations
item.description:
Trip scheduling and operations management

Controller: Controllers/Infrastructure/Operations/TripsController.cs
Route: Api/V1/Infrastructure/Trips

Public: GET /Infrastructure/Trips, GET /Infrastructure/Trips/{id}
Admin/Staff: POST, PUT, PUT /{id}/Cancel

Features:
  - Schedule trips (train + route + departure/arrival)
  - Auto-initializes TripSeats from train coaches
  - Cancel trips with passenger notifications
  - Public search for customer booking
